Palo Alto Networks is a dominant player in cybersecurity, benefiting from increasing enterprise security spend. RSI at 47 and price near SMA50 suggest a favorable entry point.
CrowdStrike is a leader in endpoint security and threat intelligence, well-positioned in the growing cybersecurity market. RSI at 45 and price near SMA50 indicate a reasonable entry.
NextEra Energy is a leader in clean energy and renewable infrastructure, aligning with the small modular reactors/clean energy theme. RSI at 52 and price near SMA50 make this an attractive entry.
